'''Albea''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] who worked for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|There's a bounty hunter coming to take you to the Empire--where you'll probably die or at least be tortured. We want to kill this bounty hunter, so it's your lucky day. Just sit quietly and be bait-like.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]], to Albea|<ref name="TOR:MS" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Albea was [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] for unknown reasons by [[Voontara Fa'athra]] in [[Fa'athra's Palace|his palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. At the same time, the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Albea, who hired [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bounty hunter named [[Rarsk]] to hunt her.<ref name="TOR:MS" />

{{GameDS}}
The prospective [[Grand Champion of the Great Hunt]] was on quest to retrieve the [[Great Hunt (c. 3643 BBY)|Great Hunt]] sponsorship token from Rarsk and saved her from the Trandoshan, only to later kill and claim her bounty.<ref name="TOR:MS" />

{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The player has the option to spare Albea instead of claiming the bounty on her, as she is not a required target of the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]].<ref name="TOR:MS" />
